subject: bitbucket: very similar repos, different behaviour

messages.author: 0521d492052ce0f0
messages.subject: bitbucket: very similar repos, different behaviour
parts:
Hi -

This might be an embarrassing mistake, but I've been thrashing around with it, have a minimal example of two public repos, and I just can't see why one exports functions and the other does not.

Both load fine on my windows 7 machine.
Both load fine on shiny server, no errors
One exports no functions on shiny server

They have identical NAMESPACE (exportPattern("*.")) and identical DESCRIPTION apart from Package:, same ./R/files, both hosted on bitbucket.

If I do the following test on my windows/R2.15.2 machine, all is well - both print the function.  The problem occurs on the shiny server spark.studio.com.

Thanks

Giles

#example----
require(devtools) #installed like winston said

#ex1: works fine
install_bitbucket("test","amberalpha")  #public repo
require(test)
print(buice)
detach("package:test", unload=TRUE)
remove.packages("test")

#ex2: errors
install_bitbucket("aa0","amberalpha")
require(aa0)
print(buice)    #error
detach("package:aa0", unload=TRUE)
remove.packages("aa0")

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: bitbucket: very similar repos, different behaviour
parts:
Looking at your source on bitbucket, I think the problem may be that in aa0, the directory is named "r" instead of "R". On Linux, filesystems are generally case-sensitive, whereas on Windows, they're not.

-Winston
